title: 1280 px boardroom slide of 5-quarter gross margin expansion
what: Gross margin rose +11.4 pp over 5 quarters (56.8% -> 68.2%) while revenue scaled to $31.8M

reader_questions.question: By how many percentage points did gross margin expand from 2025-Q2 to 2026-Q2?
